Copy link
Assignees
Labels
stale

Description

sammshen
opened on Jun 14, 2025
Issue body actions

When running a QA workload with layerwise enabled, there was a crash but only after many requests were made. Here is the log dump:
Additional Information:

  1. when running a random (store-only) workload, there were no issues
  2. the crash happened after ~200 requests were made to the system i.e. after the system has done many stores and retrieves and does not happen early on.

However, good news is that before the crash, the random workload (store only) and the synthetic workload (store and retreive KV) are both faster with layerwise!! :D
